Hi everyone!




I’m currently pursuing my Master’s degree in Data Science in Zurich while working part-time. I’m a clean, responsible, and quiet person who respects the space and takes great care of where I live. I’m looking for a cozy studio (up to CHF 1,100/month) with good connections to the city. I have a stable income, a clean credit record (Betreibungsauszug), and my full application dossier ready to go. If you have a studio available, sublet (Zwischenmiete), or lease takeover (Nachmiete), I’d love to hear from you!




Louise

Hi everyone,




My name is Alessandro, 24, and I am currently looking for a room in Zurich or the surrounding area.

I am employed full-time in a Zurich restaurant (I finish working the latest at 22:30), clean, respectful, and easy to live with. In my free time I like meeting my colleagues for a drink or going by the lake or by the river for a swim.

Ideally, I am looking for a shared apartment with a maximum of one or two other tenants, as I prefer a quieter and more comfortable living environment.




Thank you for your time and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

Alessandro

The property is spread over two levels and features:
